units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:3">Targ. Gen. I, 3</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:10:3">Koh. R. to IX, 10</cite> <he>הוא הוה גלי</he> he emigrated, v. <cite ref="C00927"><he>גְּלֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:10:3">Ib.</cite> <he>לא הֲוִינָא גלי</he> did I not emigrate?—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:10:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ויהוי מה דהוי</he> (read <he>דיהוי</he>) and come what may.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3a:11">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite> (in Hebr. diction) <he>ג׳ משמרות הוי נכ׳</he> the night consists of three watches.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3b:14">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>תרי נשפי הוו</he> there are two <cite ref="N01337"><he>נשף</he></cite> (twilights); a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 4:4:6">Y. Maasr. IV, end, 51ᶜ</cite> <he>תְּווּן מפקדין וכ׳</he> (= <he>תֶּהֱווּן</he>, or read: <he>הֱווּן</he>) give orders to your wives &c., <he>דיהוון מרימין וכ׳</he> that they (the laborers) should &c.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:2">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הוה אזלינן</he> it happened that we &c.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31b:6">Kidd. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>מרבינתיה הואי</he> (= <he>הֲוָאִית</he>) she was his foster-mother.
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:3">Ned. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>אי הואי לי</he> (Rashi <cite ref="E00230"><he>הוי</he></cite>) if I become wealthy.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:4:5">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵇ</cite> top <he>אית הוה סבין וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>איתהוה</he>, <he>איתחוון</he>, corr. acc.) there used to be old men &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:8:1">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵇ</cite> <he>אית הוו</he>.—Imper. <cite ref="E00231"><he>הֱוֵי</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="E00230">preced.</cite>

<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>זיל הוי בי רב</he> go and stay at college; a. fr.—In Palest. dialect <cite ref="J00002"><he>יֵא</he></cite>, <cite ref="J00323"><he>יֵיא</he></cite> = <he>יְהֵא</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:2">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᶜ</cite> top <he>ייא שלמא וכ׳</he> peace be with the hand &c.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="J00028"><he>יֵבָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="J00326"><he>יֵיאבָךְ</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to produce. Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ bot. דהַוִּית וכ׳ (not דהיות) where the ground used to produce &c.; Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXVI דהַוָּה; v. זַוְויֵי.

(also Peel) with ב or על to dwell upon, to discuss, argue, oppose, cmp. קים. Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵃ top על דב״ה אינון הַוִּוי they were discussing the question on the basis of Beth-Hillel’s opinion (differing as to the application of B. H.’s principle).
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 72b:13">Keth. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>הוי בה ר׳ פפא</he> R. P. (when that subject was up) raised the question.—Usu. <he>והוינן בה</he>, <he>וה׳ עלה</he> on its being brought up at college we raised the point.

<cite ref="Nazir 16b:2">Naz. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>וכולה כדה׳ בהאליבא וכ׳</he> and all this must be understood, in accordance with what we have discussed (<cite ref="Nazir 5a:13">ib. 5ᵃ</cite> sq.), in the sense of &c.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 50b:9">Kidd. 50ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מאי הַוֵּי עלה</he> what have they decided upon it?, what is the result?—[<cite ref="Niddah 66a:39">Nidd. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>תהוו … נתהוו</he>, v. <cite ref="V00114"><he>תְּהָא</he></cite>.]
